title: Implementation of a Metacognition Framework for Self-Awareness and Self-Regulation in Ensembles of LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2608.15400v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are notorious for struggling with assessing their own uncertainty, detecting knowledge conflicts, or recognizing when problems exceed their expertise; such limitations inevitably undermine reliability and trust in LLMs. In this paper, we present the first implementation of a metacognitive framework for ensembles of LLMs that addresses these challenges through explicit monitoring and control mechanisms.   Our system computes a Metacognitive State Vector (MSV) quantifying self-awareness for monitoring across five dimensions derived from cognitive psychology: Emotional Response, Correctness Evaluation, Experiential Match, Conflicting Information, and Problem Importance. MSV values also provide self-regulation for control, automatically switching between System 1 (fast, single- or multi-node) and System 2 (deliberative, multi-node) processing based on query complexity. translated_title: 在大型语言模型集成中实现用于自我意识与自我调节的元认知框架
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15400v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）以难以评估自身不确定性、检测知识冲突或识别问题超出其专业范围而闻名；这些局限性不可避免地削弱了LLMs的可靠性和信任度。在本文中，我们首次实现了针对LLM集成的元认知框架，通过显式监控和控制机制来解决这些挑战。我们的系统计算一个元认知状态向量（MSV），该向量在源自认知心理学的五个维度上量化自我意识以进行监控：情感反应、正确性评估、经验匹配、冲突信息和问题重要性。MSV值还提供用于控制的自我调节，根据查询复杂性自动在系统1（快速、单节点或多节点）和系统2（深思熟虑、多节点）处理之间切换。对于系统2执行，采用图论算法...
tldr: 本文首次实现了面向LLM集成的元认知框架，通过五维元认知状态向量实现自我监控，并基于查询复杂度自动切换快慢思维模式，以提升可靠性与自我调节能力。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first metacognitive framework for LLM ensembles, using a five-dimensional Metacognitive State Vector for self-monitoring and automatic switching between fast and slow processing modes to enhance reliability and self-regulation.
